√ci1 'gather'
present: [5.] cinóti cinuté etc. V.+ -- cinvati (3s.) -- [2.] ceti -- [1.] cayat cáyema 
perfect: cikā́ya etc. cikye cikyire etc. V.+ cicāya cicetha cicye 
aorist: [1.] acet cīyāt -- [4.] acaiṣam etc. aceṣṭa -- [5.] cayiṣṭam 
future: [1.] ceṣyáti ceṣyáte etc. B.+ -- [2.] cetā etc. 
verbal: citá V.+ cetum B.+ cetavai citvā́ B.+ cayitvā -cítya -cīya 
secondary: passive: cīyáte etc. B.+ -cīyant -- intensive: ceci- -- desiderative: cikīṣate etc. B.+ cicīṣati -- causative: cāyayate cāpayati 
derivatives: kāya E.+ caya S.+ cáyana AV.+ cayanīya C. cayitavyà MS. -cayiṣṭha RV. -cāya B. -cāyin E.+ -cāyyà B. cít B. cítya AV.B. -cityā B.+ cíti B.+ cītí AV. cetavyà B. -cetṛ B. ceya E.+ -cicīṣā C.

√ci2 'note, observe'
present: [3.] cikéṣi etc. cikīhi ciketu cikéthe cikitām cíkyat acikayus -- [5.] cinoti cinute E.+ -- [1.] cayate etc. 
perfect: cikāya etc. V.+ 
aorist: [1.] ácet ácidhvam -- [4.] aceṣṭa 
future: ceṣyati 
verbal: citá V.+ cetum E.+ -citya E.+ 
secondary: passive: cīyate etc. -- desiderative: cikīṣati cikīṣate etc. 
derivatives: -caya V.+ -cayana C. cāyaka C. -cāyin E.+ -cít RV. citi B.+ -cetavya E.+ cetṛ́ V.B. -ceya S.E. -cira RV. 
Compare √cāy, which appears to be an early specialized form of this root; cay (

ci) is another. The forms and derivatives of 2ci are not everywhere well separable from those of 1ci, and there is reason to suspect the two roots of being ultimately one; words with the prefixes nis and vi, especially, are probably best referred to 1ci, with the meaning 'take apart', and so 'resolve, decide'.
